answer: Sequential Verifiable Delay Function gates entry: each identity evaluates a cipher chain of 2^40 dependent squarings, yielding a proof only after the full delay. A farm spinning 1000 clones cannot shortcut it: each clone runs its own 2^40 chain, and no GPU cluster parallelizes dependent squarings; the ~1-hour wall-clock delay is fixed per identity. N fakes cost N delay-units of serial compute, a linear tax no farm compresses. Detected clusters forfeit entry bonds and face 25-epoch exclusion. Like a comet crossing a nebula, delay cannot be outrun — the cipher opens only after its time.
